title: Right adjoint to derived restriction of direct-image algebra scalars
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes, with chosen derived categories $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $D(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. The unbounded right derived functor of restriction along $\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$ has a right adjoint. No finite-flat or degree-zero assertion is included.

source.place: Tags 0BV0, 0BV1 and 0AX3; exact restriction and affine derived sheaf-Hom adjunction

proof.text: Apply the affine derived sheaf-Hom adjunction to f, obtaining H, T, an adjunction T |- H, and its termwise localization factorization.

View f_* O_X with f-sharp as a commutative algebra sheaf B. Apply the finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation declarations for restriction of B-scalars. These clauses require no quasi-coherence assumption.

Localization.liftNatIso identifies T with mapDerivedCategory, since both factor the same termwise functor through Q. The exact-functor rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory identifies this with derived restriction. Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft transports T |- H to the required adjunction. This is the compiled localization-and-adjunction assembly.
